issues.problem: The local test runs `python3 app.py &` and then `curl` straight away. curl can run before the server has bound port 8000 and fail with 'connection refused', which makes learners think their code is broken.
issues.fix: Add a short wait before the curl, e.g. `python3 app.py & sleep 1; curl -s localhost:8000/; echo; kill %1`, or tell learners to wait until 'listening on 8000' is printed before running curl.
